card.name: Words inside stock disclaimer sentences
card.fires_on: Ordinary words in the middle of fixed disclaimer or credit sentences, such as "or other qualified health provider" or "If no author is given". Also a few names in author credits.

modes.label: Health disclaimers
modes.description: A linking or modifying word in the standard 'seek advice of your physician' or 'self-treatment is not recommended' sentences.
modes.example: Always seek the advice of your physician or<< other>> qualified health provider prior to starting any new

modes.label: Source and author notes
modes.description: The word 'given' in the note about a missing author, or a middle name or initial in an author credit.
modes.example: Note: If no author is<< given>>, the source is cited instead.

card.plain: It lights up on middle words of repeated legal-style notices, like the 'ask your doctor' disclaimer and 'no author given' notes.
